note: Per-area clock rules for the Rift. drainMultiplier 0 = the clock stands still, 0.5 = half speed, 2 = double. minimumSeconds is what the area REQUIRES you to be holding, not what it takes. exitSeconds is a hand-estimated walk back to somewhere that does not drain, and is only used to decide when to warn. certainty is CONFIRMED once somebody has watched the clock do it in game; everything here is WIKI until then.
